titre: Pass'Sport: a discount on sports club membership
resume: €50 off membership of a sports club for 2026-2027, to be used before December 31, 2026: who is eligible, how to get the code and what to bring to the club.
aQuoiCaSert: The Pass'Sport (a government sports grant for young people) reduces the cost of enrolling your child in a sports club or a partner gym. The club deducts €50 directly from the license or membership fee. If the fee is below €50, the club undertakes to give the young person the benefit of the difference (equipment, sportswear).
quiEstConcerne: Young people aged 6 to 17 (inclusive) whose Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) or MSA (Mutualité sociale agricole, the farmers' social security fund) family quotient is €699 or less.
Young people aged 6 to 19 (inclusive) receiving the AEEH (disabled child education allowance), and aged 16 to 30 (inclusive) receiving the AAH (adult disability allowance).
Students on grants under 28 (needs-based grant, annual Crous student services aid, regional grant for health and social care training).
aSavoir: Amount for 2026-2027: €50 per young person (€70 in 2025-2026).
Valid for enrollments made between September 1 and December 31, 2026.
Codes were emailed from September 9 to 13, 2026, to the address known to the Caf, the MSA or the Crous, with one email per eligible minor child. Remember to check your spam folder.
No email: check eligibility on the official website, then request the code online (FranceConnect recommended). It arrives by email within 72 hours at most.

Separated parents: eligibility depends on the family quotient of the main Caf beneficiary. The code is therefore sent to that parent's email address: share it if the other parent is enrolling the child.

An additional Caf grant for equipment has been announced for the 1st quarter of 2027 for beneficiaries aged 6 to 17 who activated their Pass'Sport at the start of the 2026 school year. Its amount has not been specified.
